data.name: Armbrecht
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old German, the name Armbrecht translates to ‘ruler of the strong arms’. The name was commonly given to boys in the Middle Ages, reflecting the value placed on strength and martial prowess during that period.

In the biblical sense, having 'strong arms' signifies the ability to carry the burdens of life and face challenges with unwavering faith. This name encourages its bearer to lean on God's strength in times of hardship, trusting in the divine provision and guidance.
